title: Principal/getAvailability omits event/accountId instead of null when showDetails is false
description: draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-34 §2.2 BusyPeriod: event is CalendarEvent|null, null when showDetails is false, the event is private, or mayReadItems is missing; accountId is Id|null, null when event is null. handle_principal_get_availability (crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/principal.rs) instead omits both members when showDetails is false (its rustdoc says 'omitted'). Send them as null. Found while testing JMAP-lehj.11 (tests/availability.rs compares only utcStart/utcEnd/busyStatus for now).
close_reason: BusyPeriod event/accountId serialize as null (not omitted); getAvailability nulls them when showDetails is false; type test updated to the -34 shape
